description: This file defines a singleton object 'CalculationHistory' that manages an in-memory, application-wide persistent store for calculator expressions and results. It provides methods to add, retrieve, remove individual entries, and clear the entire history.

classes.name: HistoryEntry
classes.description: A data class representing a single entry in the calculation history, including the expression, result, and timestamp.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new calculation expression and result to the history, maintaining a maximum limit of entries.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Returns a list of all calculation history entries, most recent first.

methods.name: removeAt
methods.description: Removes a history entry at the specified index, if valid.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the calculation history.
